authority.title: Autodesk HATCH and MPOLYGON DXF reference
authority.finding: MPOLYGON group 63 specifies pattern fill color as an ACI, separate from common entity color.

problem: A bounded solid MPOLYGON with fill ACI 3 and BYLAYER entity color rendered white rather than green.
change: Represent an explicit ACI solid fill separately from common entity color for non-gradient DXF MPOLYGONs; use it in canvas drawing while preserving selection color precedence. Unsupported fill-color forms retain the previous path.

validation.canvas_tests: 4 passed, including fill vs line color, cached draw, selected highlight, and pattern fallback
validation.dwg_tests: 17 passed, including explicit red entity/green fill, move metadata, and output groups 62/63
validation.native: Instrumented current viewer frame showed white before and green after. Opened source, saved as AC1018 ASCII and reopened output with the existing MPOLYGON-as-HATCH notice. The OS window screenshot remained black.
validation.independent: ezdxf 1.4.5 verified source and saved MPOLYGON subtype, ACI fill 3, BYLAYER common color, vertices and offset, with zero errors or fixes.

limits: Native build uses scratch GL tracing and isolated title/identity; it is not a release binary.
No native MPOLYGON edit/transform or uninstrumented visible display is claimed.
ACI ByBlock/ByLayer, gradient, true-color, named colors, DWG MPOLYGON fills and broader profiles remain unqualified.
No independent producer source or Linux/Windows native qualification.
